text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything you want? Don't be shy, 
just name it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You say that every year, 
Dia-chan, but you'd really give me 
literally "anything," so I have to be 
careful.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“—Yeah, I've decided! Dia-chan, please 
keep running with me forever and ever!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Forever, you say... Hehe. You really are 
quite demanding, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Y-You think so? This is really the 
only favor I have to ask, though...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's true~. But don't worry. I can be 
just as selfish as you, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because the second I heard that wish... I 
couldn't help but think, "Wait, you don't 
want it to be 'every single day 
forever'?"♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Wah~...! Yeah, every day!\nThat's 
perfect!!\nI'd much rather wish for 
that!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. You always grant my wishes way 
better than I could ever imagine♪
